remarks: Welcome to this stunning 2,616 sq ft home, nestled on a picturesque Stamford street within the desirable Club Road community. Perfect for family living, the property welcomes you with a functional circular driveway and a two-car garage. Inside, gleaming hardwood floors guide you through a bright, open-concept main level. The heart of the home is the beautiful eat-in kitchen, featuring a large center island that flows seamlessly into the dining area. Gather for cozy family evenings in the living room by the fireplace, or head to the expansive family room-an ideal multi-use space for a play area, media room, or home bar. Upstairs are four spacious bedrooms, including a private primary suite with a walk-in closet and a freshly updated en suite bathroom. An additional full bath on the upper level serves the rest of the bedrooms with hardwood underneath carpet. The basement offers ample storage space for extra belongings. The outdoor space is a family paradise. The gorgeous stone patio has an outdoor countertop, roughed-in sink, and space for grilling. The fully fenced backyard to play, and can host summer barbecues with ease. Located in a warm, welcoming community, you are just minutes from local shops and restaurants. This home offers the perfect blend of neighborhood charm and everyday convenience. See attached list of home updates and highlights.
